title: Cancellation of a Linden Membership: Notice, Early Termination, Cooling-Off and Dues Credits
content:
## 1. Who cancels, and when it takes effect

1.1 Only the member can cancel a membership of Linden Memberships. A member whose membership is active or frozen gives notice of cancellation, and the membership moves to cancellation pending.

1.2 A cancellation takes effect the tier's cancellation notice in days after the notice; the records show the notice date and the effective date, the effective date being the notice date plus the tier's notice days.

1.3 The member may rescind the notice before it takes effect. The membership then returns to active and the notice and effective dates are cleared.

1.4 When the notice period ends, the cancellation takes effect: the membership closes as cancelled on the effective date, and any member visit credits remaining expire.

## 2. Early termination fee

2.1 A cancellation taking effect before the commitment end date is charged the tier's early termination fee.

2.2 The commitment end date is a date on the membership record. A cancellation whose effective date is on or after that date ends the membership after the commitment and carries no early termination fee.

## 3. Cooling-off period

3.1 A cancellation noticed within the cooling-off period refunds all dues and the enrollment fee and carries no early termination fee.

3.2 The notice is given no later than the tier's cooling-off period counted from the enrollment date. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the enrollment date, and a notice on the last day still qualifies.

3.3 The enrollment date is read from the membership record.

| Hypothetical enrollment date | Cooling-off period | Last qualifying notice day | Notice on 15 March | Notice on 16 March |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 14 days | 15 March (day 1 is 2 March) | Within: full refund of dues and enrollment fee, no early termination fee | Outside |

| Hypothetical enrollment date | Cooling-off period | Last qualifying notice day |
|---|---|---|
| 10 April | 30 days | 10 May |
| 20 January | 14 days | 3 February |

## 4. Dues credits outside the cooling-off period

4.1 Outside the cooling-off period, annual dues are credited per the tier's annual refund basis:

| Annual refund basis | Annual dues credited |
|---|---|
| Prorated by full months | Each full month remaining after the effective date |
| Prorated after the commitment | Each full month remaining after the effective date, but only months after the commitment end date |
| None after the cooling-off period | Nothing |

4.2 Monthly dues are never prorated.

### Counting the months (hypothetical)

A membership on the annual cycle has a membership year from 1 February to 31 January, a commitment end date of 31 August and a cancellation effective 20 June, outside the cooling-off period.

- Prorated by full months: the full months remaining after 20 June are July through January, 7 months credited.
- Prorated after the commitment: of those 7 months, the months after 31 August are September through January, 5 months credited.
- None after the cooling-off period: no month is credited.

The same membership on the monthly cycle would receive no proration of its monthly dues.
